title: Spell Fusion Wizard
description: A blue-skinned female wizard with pink hair kneels on cracked purple stone, wielding a glowing hammer crackling with blue lightning while holding a smartphone. Behind her, a giant red dragon coils across the scene toward a menacing gothic castle with glowing windows, under a swirling sky with a crowned smiling moon, a sun, floating jellyfish, and small figures running.
prompt: A vibrant fantasy scene featuring a blue-skinned female wizard with pink hair kneeling on broken stone, holding a glowing smartphone in one hand and swinging a large hammer that emits powerful blue lightning. A massive red dragon flies across the middle ground. In the background stands a dark gothic castle with glowing pink windows and a monstrous face on its facade. The swirling sky contains a smiling crowned crescent moon, a sun, and several floating jellyfish. Small human figures run across the scene. Highly detailed, colorful, dynamic composition.
